name: Italy
shortSummary: India-Italy ties were significantly strained by the 2012 "Enrica Lexie" case, in which Italian marines shot Indian fishermen; relations have since normalized following international arbitration and a renewed Strategic Partnership.
complexity: The 2012 killing of two Indian fishermen by Italian marines aboard the oil tanker Enrica Lexie triggered a years-long legal and diplomatic dispute, resolved via a 2020 Permanent Court of Arbitration ruling.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Italian machinery and design expertise support Indian manufacturing and textile sectors.

majorChallenges.title: Legacy of the Enrica Lexie case
majorChallenges.description: The 2012 incident left lasting sensitivities despite legal resolution.

recentDevelopments.title: Strategic Partnership implementation continues
recentDevelopments.description: Following the 2023 elevation to a Strategic Partnership under PM Meloni, both sides continued expanding defence and technology cooperation.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Marks a full normalization from the 2012-2020 Enrica Lexie-era strain.

historicalEvents.title: Enrica Lexie Incident
historicalEvents.description: Italian marines aboard the tanker Enrica Lexie shoot and kill two Indian fishermen off the Kerala coast, triggering a prolonged bilateral legal dispute.

historicalEvents.title: Permanent Court of Arbitration Ruling
historicalEvents.description: An international tribunal rules on jurisdiction and compensation in the Enrica Lexie case, allowing both governments to normalise relations.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Italy elevate ties to a Strategic Partnership during PM Meloni's visit.

agreements.name: India-Italy Strategic Partnership
agreements.description: Framework agreement expanding defence, trade and technology cooperation.

multilateralRelations.detail: Italy engages India on Indo-Mediterranean connectivity, including IMEC.
